summary: Play the audiobooks on your Kobo, with chapters, speed, a sleep timer and your place kept. Or make one from a topic.
release_notes: The book playing is listed once, and a book made here is labelled MP3 and has its title alone on its cover.

steps.text: Set up the reader once over USB, if you have not already.

Plug the reader in, open its storage and copy audiobooks into a folder called Audiobooks: an .m4b, .m4a, .mp3, .ogg, .opus, .flac or .wav file is one book, and a folder of numbered files is one book with a part per file.
Open Audiobooks, tap a book, and connect headphones or a speaker when asked. Tapping a book later carries on where you left it.

To make a book from a topic instead, create an API key with Exa, OpenAI and ElevenLabs, save them in ~/.exa, ~/.openai and ~/.elevenlabs, and install each with its command. It shows the time and cost before anything is spent.
